description: Records skill-firing + task-boundary telemetry on PostToolUse (Read stamps a resumed-from event on handoff reads; Write triggers the ce-session marker stamp on handoff writes), emits a mid-session, boundary-gated handoff nudge on UserPromptSubmit when context load is high at a clean stopping point, and keeps the turn-count Stop nudge as a late backstop (trial). All hooks fail open — never block the harness.
